name: Jeton
mood: Editorial fintech on warm marble, with a near-white canvas, searing orange-red emphasis, warm near-black text, tight oversized headlines, and spacious rounded cards.

signalOrange.role: Primary brand accent for links, icons, key headings, and main emphasis.

brandOrangeTint.role: Softer orange variant for small brand indicators and secondary brand details.

inkRoast.role: Warm near-black for body copy, headings, inputs, and editorial text.

paperWhite.role: Dominant page canvas and card surface.

carbonBlack.role: Utility icon color, compact labels, and rare meta details.

ashGrey.role: Disabled, placeholder, divider, and low-emphasis details.

sandWash.role: Warm neutral wash for subtle separation.

linenBlush.role: Pale orange-tinted surface for inputs, rows, highlights, and soft cards.

mintWash.role: Soft green wash for emphasis, funding, and positive moments.

emeraldGreen.role: Add, funding, or positive category accent.

families.fallback: Inter, Manrope, DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui

rules: Use one geometric grotesque family across the UI.
Use scale and tight leading for hierarchy rather than heavier weights.
Keep display tracking around 0.01em and small text tracking around 0.03em.

orangeTint.role: Warm highlighted content and input surface.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.recipe: Signal Orange fill, white text, 12px radius, 8px vertical and 16px horizontal padding, 14px type, weight 450, 0.03em tracking.

components.name: Ghost Text Link
components.recipe: No fill, Signal Orange text, 8px radius, 8px padding, optional arrow indicator.

components.name: White Ghost Button
components.recipe: Transparent surface, white text, 1px white border, 84px radius, 16px horizontal padding.

components.name: Feature Category Card
components.recipe: Pastel-tinted background, 16px radius, large geometric icon, category heading, and one category accent.

components.name: Floating Input Field
components.recipe: Orange alpha background, Ink Roast text, 16px radius, generous icon padding, minimal border.

components.name: Top Navigation Bar
components.recipe: Logo left, nav center, toggle and CTA right, 14-16px type, pill controls, optional backdrop blur.

do: Use oversized display type with 0.9-1.0 leading.
Keep Signal Orange as the main accent.
Use category accents only inside feature cards.
Use 16px rounding for cards and inputs.
Use warm-tinted surfaces with Ink Roast text.
dont: Do not add a second typeface.
Do not add heavy shadows to text or buttons.
Do not use pure black for body text.
Do not multiply accent colors in one component.
Do not use sharp interactive corners.

imagery.style: Typography-first, geometric, abstract, product-adjacent, and warm.
notes: Use abstract fintech/product visuals instead of lifestyle photography.
Simple geometric icons should carry category meaning.
If product imagery appears, use tight crops and warm grading.

layout.hero: Large left-aligned editorial headline with extreme whitespace and a small orange CTA.
layout.sections: Full-width bands separated by 80px or more; mostly white with occasional warm/pastel tint.
layout.grids: Spacious two or three column cards; avoid dense matrix layouts.
layout.rhythm: Headline, short copy, whitespace, geometric card or input, repeat.

preview.note: Refero exposes preview imagery, but local download was not captured in this environment.
